responsibility: Supplies ELF object-format and linker/assembler conventions for Alpha ELF targets. It overrides specs and asm-output macros for alignment, BSS/small-data emission, symbol aliasing, unwind-table defaults, EH pointer encodings, literal/gpdisp prescan bookkeeping, and CRT static-function call sequences, providing the ABI glue between the generic Alpha backend and ELF-based assemblers, linkers, and runtime startup code.
same_name_distinction: Within the elf stem, this is the Alpha ELF subtarget header that defines ELF-specific specs and assembler/object-format macros, whereas elf.opt only declares the corresponding ELF-specific command-line option recognized by the driver.
